name: Maya Chen
bio: Founder of Tracewell, open-source tracing for LLM agents. Ex-Datadog.
shareableGoal: Raise a seed round for Tracewell and meet investors who know developer tools.
privateIntent: Already has a soft lead at 1.5M; wants one more angel with infra operator experience, and would rather not talk to generalist funds.

name: Dev Raman
bio: Partner at Lantern Ventures. Writes pre-seed and seed checks in AI infrastructure.
shareableGoal: Meet founders building AI infrastructure or developer tools before they raise.
privateIntent: Fund is nearly fully deployed this quarter; looking for two more seed deals, strongly prefers technical solo founders.

name: Priya Nair
bio: Founder of Ledgerline, AI bookkeeping for small restaurants. 40 paying customers.
shareableGoal: Hire a first engineer who likes owning the whole stack.
privateIntent: Can offer 1.5 to 2 percent equity and a below-market salary until the seed closes; worried about candidates who only want big-company process.

name: Leo Okafor
bio: Founder of Pollen, a booking app for independent fitness studios. Just raised a pre-seed.
shareableGoal: Find a first designer and a first sales hire for Pollen.
privateIntent: The current app was built from templates and churn is high; needs someone who can redo onboarding fast, and a seller who has sold to gyms before.

name: Sam Rivera
bio: Second-time founder, now exploring ideas in climate and community software. Loves introductions.
shareableGoal: Meet curious people, swap ideas and make useful introductions.
privateIntent: Quietly looking for a cofounder for the next company; wants to see who is energetic and generous with ideas.

name: Jordan Park
bio: Senior backend engineer at a payments company. Builds distributed systems and agent tooling on weekends.
shareableGoal: Explore joining an early-stage startup as a founding engineer.
privateIntent: Has a big-company offer that expires in three weeks; would leave for the right founder, needs at least a modest salary.
